subject: Proportional surge graceband and PO lane for May launch overrun
messages:
From: Clare North <ops@clearnorth.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.inference
Cc: billing@clearnorth.com
Date: 2026-06-13T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick: invoice / overage for May launch

Hi Laura,

We went live with the new recommendation flow on May 31 and saw a much larger token footprint than our tests — big congrats on the stability by the way. Unfortunately that pushed us over our agreed monthly quota and we've already hit the first overrun tier. Our finance team is flagging the invoice and asking if there's any way to soften the hit while we process an updated PO.

Attached is a small usage snapshot for the weekend spike so you can see the distribution. We would propose either a short grace period while we route the PO, or a one-time partial waiver given this was a launch-day anomaly. Happy to hop on a call if that helps.

Thanks —
Clare
Clare North
Head of Platform, ClearNorth
ops@clearnorth.com

Attachments: ClearNorth_usage_snapshot_May2026.csv (csv, 12KB)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.inference
To: Clare North <ops@clearnorth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.inference, karthik_iyer@redwood.inference
Date: 2026-06-13T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick: invoice / overage for May launch

Hi Clare — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the launch. I pulled your usage and can see a concentrated burst on 5/31 that accounts for ~48% of the month-overrun.

Proposal (to get finance and ops moving quickly):
- Proportional graceband: waive 50% of the first overage slab for this specific launch event (one-time).
- Blended rate for residual: after the waived portion, the remaining overage for May would be billed at a blended rate that is 12% lower than your standard overrun slab for the month.
- PO path: we’ll accept an expedited PO referencing this email; Ben copied here will coordinate the PO template and timing so billing can apply the adjustments on the next invoice cycle.

I attached a draft PO template with the language we usually need to apply a retroactive adjustment. If Ben or Karthik need different wording we can iterate. If that sounds OK, I’ll confirm internally and ask finance to hold collection while we close the PO.

Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.inference

Attachments: Draft_PO_template_ClearNorth.pdf (pdf, 45KB)

From: ben_carter@redwood.inference
To: laura_bennett@redwood.inference
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.inference, Clare North <ops@clearnorth.com>, billing@clearnorth.com
Date: 2026-06-14T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick: invoice / overage for May launch

Laura / Clare —

I like the proportional graceband approach; operationally we can implement it without a contract amendment if ClearNorth signs a PO that references the deal id (DN-4823) and the adjustment language. Two operational notes:
1) We will need the PO within 10 business days for us to adjust May's invoice; otherwise it will post as a standard overrun and we will apply a credit on the next cycle.
2) For accounting, we need ClearNorth to confirm whether they prefer a credit line on the June invoice or a direct reduction to the May amount (our default is a June credit).

Suggested billing language to include in the PO: "Redwood Inference shall waive 50% of the first monthly overrun slab incurred during the May 2026 ClearNorth production launch for DN-4823, and the remaining overrun for May 2026 shall be billed at a blended rate equal to 88% of the standard overrun slab. This one-time concession is conditioned on ClearNorth providing an approved PO within 10 business days."

If that wording works, I can draft a clean PO quote and route it through our finance portal. Karthik — please flag if we need a technical note for the usage window.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Sales Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.inference
To: Clare North <ops@clearnorth.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.inference
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.inference, billing@clearnorth.com
Date: 2026-06-15T17:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick: invoice / overage for May launch

Hi Clare — quick technical confirmation from our side: the spike on 5/31 looks like sustained peak QPS for a 4-hour window driven by combined realtime recommend + batch enrichment calls. No persistent misrouting. From a tooling standpoint we can add a short-term throttle or apply an auto-burst policy, but that won’t retroactively change May’s tokens.

Operational next steps to finalize the concession:
- If ClearNorth signs the PO with the suggested language, Ben will submit the PO to finance and we will tag the May invoice for a one-time adjustment.
- Please indicate whether you want the adjustment as a credit on the June invoice or a corrected May invoice amount (Ben will confirm impact on your AP workflow).
- If you prefer an extra safety net going forward, we can include a temporary burst buffer for July (30% headroom, billed as a commitment add-on) so you avoid repeat escalations while ramping.

Happy to jump on a call if you want to walk through the usage CSV.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.inference
